email.subject1: a signal play for your partners
email.body1:
Olesya, saw Orum shipped a redesigned AI Dialer and now runs over a million daily calls.

When the platform scales like that, partner-sourced pipeline often cannot keep up, because covering every reseller and tech partner by hand is more than a team can touch. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for the Orum partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Olesya, quick follow-up for Orum.

Most partnerships teams know exactly which tech and reseller partners to co-sell into but cannot work them all by hand, so the best targets sit untouched and partner-sourced pipeline plateaus.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three top partner targets for Orum. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them, then show how the same engine runs the whole partner ecosystem?
email.body3:
Olesya, last bit of proof for Orum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Orum's partner reply rate likely compares to other ecosystem-led teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Olesya, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and I know a platform relaunch keeps the team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook scoped to your partner motion? I will tailor it to Orum either way.
